headlines.text: Flash back to 2025, when the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Kyle Fletcher vs. Ace Austin went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 8.14 ? a real highlight of the night. For Ace Austin, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. It marked Kyle Fletcher's 10th match with the title on the line. Fletcher defended the TNT Championship against Ace Austin of the Bang Bang Gang in a hard-fought outing that tested the young champion's mettle.

Looking back to 2023, when MJF vs. Daniel Garcia clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.70. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

Turning the clock back to 2024: Alex Reynolds reached a solid half-century of matches: their 50th match in AEW, facing The Undisputed Kingdom vs. Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) vs. The Infantry on Rampage, rated 5.59 in a physical tag team battle.

secondaries.text: That Saturday in 2025, Roderick Strong vs. Jon Moxley met in an Advantage Battle, in the night's main event on Collision, rated 7.77 ? a well-worked match.
On this day in 2023, Swerve Strickland vs. Penta El Zero M locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 7.81 ? a match that delivered.
Flash back to 2025, when Collision stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.38.
